enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Take toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Wipe counter.

Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt, pants, socks, underwear. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Check email. Put phone in pocket. Walk out.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container. Make sandwich. Put sandwich in container. Put container in bag. Take out apple. Put apple in bag. Fill water bottle. Put water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to work by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Get off train. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Check emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Organize files. Meet with clients. Write reports. Print documents. Attend lunch. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Attend afternoon meeting. Make copies. Send emails. Organize event. Leave office.

Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Put pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Wipe table.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch show. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch more TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for login. Type password. Open project file. Edit document. Type text. Save file. Open browser. Search for information. Read article. Take notes. Close browser. Continue editing. Save file. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading, and using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Put book down. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check social media. Watch video. Put phone down. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
